aarti.tek: a crown shines on your head.
aarti.pad1: Betel leaves are offered to you, flowers are offered to you,
and a stream of milk is poured over you.
aarti.pad2: Your parikramā is seven kos long;
aarti.pad3: on your chin are a diamond and a ruby.
aarti.pad4: the adorned sight of you is grand.
aarti.pad5: Lord, holder of Girirāja, I am in your refuge:
